groups.sub: Repositories that change together. A ticket made from a group works in all of them and opens a pull request in each one it changes.
groups.none: No groups yet. A group lets one ticket change several repositories, such as an API and its web app.
groups.drawerSub: Repositories that change together, in order: the first is the primary repository of the group's tickets.
groups.name: Name
groups.membersHelp: Order matters: the first is the primary repository. A role tells agnts what each one is, such as backend or web.
groups.noMoreRepos: Every active repository is in the group
groups.prefixHelp: Key prefix of tasks made from the group, as {prefix}-12. Empty uses the first repository's.
groups.instructionsPh: The web app calls the API through src/api; change both together and keep the OpenAPI spec in sync.
groups.instructionsHelp: How the repositories fit together, in Markdown. Added to every prompt of the group's tickets.
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete the group {name}? Its tickets keep their repositories.
groups.retryHint: {count, plural, one {A retry pushes the # repository that failed; the others stay as they are.} other {A retry pushes the # repositories that failed; the others stay as they are.}}
groups.maxTicketReposHelp: How many repositories one ticket, and one repository group, may have.
